evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: LLM agents are increasingly used for security tasks: vulnerability discovery, exploit reproduction, and patch generation.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: A convergence detector monitors the gradient signal itself and stops once the context has absorbed the generalizable information in the training data, without held-out validation data.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: With fewer than 200 training examples, SelfOp yields a 17-point self-improvement for GPT-5.4-mini (with Codex), enough to surpass the frontier GPT-5.4 baseline by 6 points, and an 18.5-point self-improvement for GPT-5.4 itself.
